verdict.rationale: Locking an authenticator app behind biometrics or a PIN is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an app lock for 2FAS Auth. The closest items are 2FAS Pass 'Security Tiers' for protecting individual vault items and in-app confirmation of browser-extension or autofill requests. Those are related controls, not a biometric or PIN lock on opening the app, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
